title: Create src/lib/backends/types.ts — AgentBackend interface
description: Define the TypeScript interface for AI agent backends. All backends must implement this interface. Also defines BackendOptions and ParsedOutput types.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentBackend interface is exported with name, spawn, and parseOutput members

steps.details: Create the file. Define: export type BackendOptions = { prompt: string; maxIterations?: number; cwd?: string }

Define: export type ParsedOutput = | { type: 'text'; content: string } | { type: 'json'; data: unknown } | { type: 'complete' } | { type: 'blocked'; reason: string } | { type: 'decide'; question: string }
Define: export interface AgentBackend { name: string; spawn(prompt: string, options: BackendOptions): import('child_process').ChildProcess; parseOutput(line: string): ParsedOutput | null; }
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and confirm types.ts compiles without errors.

technicalNotes: Using a discriminated union for ParsedOutput allows exhaustive type checking in switch statements
The import('child_process').ChildProcess pattern avoids a top-level import that might not be needed in all contexts
